heading: EXT. CITY HALL PLAZA - CLIMATE PROTEST - DAY

units.text: EXT. CITY HALL PLAZA - CLIMATE PROTEST - DAY
SUPER: "THURSDAY, 2:14 PM"

A river of banners and drums and kids on shoulders pours across the plaza, whistles shrieking and a brass band somewhere playing something almost like a hymn, and at the edge of the crowd under a dead plane tree four people in orange vests drift together, not looking at one another, while a police helicopter chops overhead and a woman on a megaphone leads a chant that rolls back and forth like surf.
INSERT - A CITY MAP on a phone, the bank across the plaza circled in red.
SUPER: "ARCHIVE VAULT, FLOOR B2"
The four close ranks.
MIRA ADEYEMI, 30s, sunglasses pushed up, holds a placard that says THERE IS NO PLANET B. Beside her, TOBIAS WREN, 50s, the team's old safe man, carries a cardboard sun on a stick.
Everybody breathe. We hold the crowd until the alarm trips, the guards come out, and then we walk in through the loading dock like we're delivering pamphlets. Forty seconds. That's the whole plan.
units.name: MIRA

units.text: You said that about the last one.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: The last one had a dog.
units.name: MIRA

units.text: JUNO PARK, 20s, in a hand-knit hat, scrolls through a message thread on her phone, a chant in her ears.
Dock crew says the guards changed shift early. Two minutes ago. They won't be where we mapped them.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: Which means we move now, not later. Tobias, the code?
units.name: MIRA

units.text: Right here in my pocket, same as it's been for eleven years, and if you look at it, Mira, I swear on my mother's pension I will fall apart.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: The sun's wobbling.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: It's a very old sun.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: The brass band swells.
A drum thunders.
The crowd surges left, a wall of orange and green flags.
RAFA DELACROIX, 40s, ear-piece in, drifts into the circle from the back, face grey, shoulder-checking the crowd.
We have a problem. One of the vests across the plaza has a radio and a plain jacket underneath. They're not guards. They're federal.
units.name: RAFA

units.text: Then they are here for someone else.
units.name: MIRA
paren: a long beat, lips barely moving

units.text: Mira. They are here for us.
units.name: RAFA

units.text: Well. That is a very short plan.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Message from the dock. It says: WHERE ARE YOU. IT'S NOT SAFE. LEAVE NOW.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: Everybody walk. Don't run. Join the march, lose the vests, and meet at the van. Nobody looks back.
units.name: MIRA
paren: closing her eyes, then opening them, quiet

units.text: And the vault?
units.name: RAFA

units.text: The vault has waited a hundred years. It can wait another one.
units.name: MIRA
paren: gently, to the crowd, the sky, to herself

units.text: The chant swells.
Rain begins, thin and sudden.
The four melt into the crowd one by one.
